gestures.description: Barmoqlar ohista titrab pastga qor yog'ishi ifodalanadi

gestures.name: Shamol
gestures.description: Ikkala qo'l bir tomonga to'lqinsimon esadi

gestures.name: Issiq
gestures.description: Peshonadan ter artish harakati

gestures.name: Sovuq
gestures.description: Ikkala musht siqilib tana titraydi

gestures.name: Osmon
gestures.description: Kaft yuqoriga qaragan holda kenglik ifodalanadi

gestures.name: Yer (Zamin)
gestures.description: Kaftlar pastga qaratilib tekis yuza ko'rsatiladi

gestures.name: Gul
gestures.description: Barmoqlar birlashib burunga gul hidlagandek tutiladi

gestures.name: Daraxt
gestures.description: Tirsak tik qo'yilib, barmoqlar shox-shabbalardek yoziladi

gestures.name: Katta (Ulkan)
gestures.description: Ikkala qo'l ikki tomonga keng yoziladi

gestures.name: Kichik (Mayda)
gestures.description: Bosh barmoq va ko'rsatkich orasida ozgina masofa qoldiriladi

gestures.name: Yangi
gestures.description: Chap kaftdan o'ng qo'l yuqoriga porlab chiqadi

gestures.name: Eski
gestures.description: Iyakdan soqol tortgandek qo'l pastga tortiladi

gestures.name: Chiroyli / Go'zal
gestures.description: Besh barmoq yuz atrofida aylanib go'zallik ifodalanadi

gestures.name: Qimmat
gestures.description: Pul belgisi yuqoriga otiladi

gestures.name: Arzon
gestures.description: Pul belgisi pastga tushiriladi

gestures.name: Oson
gestures.description: Barmoqlar yengil silkinadi

gestures.name: Qiyin (Murakkab)
gestures.description: Bukilgan ko'rsatkich barmoqlar bir-biriga uriladi

gestures.name: Toza (Ozoda)
gestures.description: O'ng kaft chap kaft ustidan sirg'alib tozalaydi

gestures.name: Ochiq
gestures.description: Ikkala kaft ikki tomonga eshikdek ochiladi

gestures.name: Yopiq
gestures.description: Ikkala kaft birlashtirilib yopiladi
